items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: he was playing with us too when he could

ctx.x: Yeah - and he was playing with us too when he could---
He also played under the name of Jack Goss.

Yeah and we had been up to see him and, so, I had an open Packard at that time and, uh, I said to Tesh -- we'll drive you home, and so that was at Magnolia and Wilson--- that this happened and Magnolia going into Wilson was a stop street--- and we stopped there and looked both ways - saw nothing and I pulled out -- and what happened -- here comes a cab with no lights; we didn't see him and he hit us broadside--- and knocked us into a tree and I went through the drug store window and Tesh had his hands in his…
